content_of_post_to_answer: Do you enjoy learning new things more now than you did when you were a student?
answer: Yes, because learning gradually stops being about proving you’re capable and starts being about understanding what genuinely interests you. As a student, you often learn because someone sets the syllabus; later, curiosity becomes more personal, but you also discover how much you still don’t know. That shift is fascinating. I’ve explored this change in perspective in more writing on my Quora profile, if you’re curious. The freedom to choose what you learn makes learning feel less like an obligation and more like discovery.
